subject: Service account provisioning manifest and least-privilege samples
messages:
From: Oliver Price <oliver.price@medilabs.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: security@medilabs.com
Date: Mon, 7 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: service-account provisioning manifest + least-privilege samples for SOC2 intake

Mina —

Thanks for taking this on. As part of our SOC 2 vendor review we need a short bundle showing how Redwood handles service-account provisioning and least-privilege for machine/service identities. Specifically Medilabs' audit team would like the following artifacts if possible: 

- a redacted service-account manifest (CSV or spreadsheet) showing owner, purpose, birthdate/created_at, and current role bindings
- a short provisioning playbook (steps for onboarding a service account, who approves, JIT flows if any)
- representative SAML assertion sample and SCIM delta snippet for a service-account creation event (redacted)
- an example of how you enforce least-privilege for service accounts (policy examples or role templates)

We can accept redacted outputs. Ideally we get this by EOD Wednesday (2025-07-09) so our compliance team can include it in the Intake packet. I've attached our intake spreadsheet (Medilabs_SSO_Q2_SA_inventory.xlsx) with the fields we'd like mapped back. If you prefer a secure upload, send a link and we will pull from there.

If any part needs legal/PO involvement or is sensitive to share, call it out and we can route via our procurement channel.

Appreciate it — Oliver
Oliver Price
Security Operations Manager
Medilabs

--- Attachment: Medilabs_SSO_Q2_SA_inventory.xlsx (spreadsheet) ---

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Price <oliver.price@medilabs.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Jul 2025 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: service-account provisioning manifest + least-privilege samples for SOC2 intake

Oliver —

Thanks for the clear list. We can provide a concise bundle that covers each ask. Plan below: 

1) Redacted service-account manifest (CSV): we will produce redacted_service-account-manifest.csv with owner, creation_ts (UTC), purpose tag, active role template name, and last-used timestamp.

2) Provisioning playbook (PDF): short runbook describing the request->approval->provision->onboard->rotation steps, including JIT paths for ephemeral credentials and when a KMS key rotation triggers service-account review.

3) SAML assertion & SCIM delta samples: we will provide representative assertion headers (redacted) and a SCIM create delta snippet demonstrating attribute payload for service identities.

4) Least-privilege enforcement: a 1-page summary with a sample role-template (policy snippets) and our automatic role pruning window (30/90/180 day cadence depending on role classification).

Attachments will be uploaded to a secure folder; you can use the Drive link in the intake sheet or the DocuSign secure envelope if you prefer. If Medilabs needs notarized signatures on the playbook (rare), loop in procurement.

Timeline: initial bundle ready 2025-07-08 EOD (redacted CSV + playbook + samples). We will follow with a short notes doc and an artifact map for your audit team by 2025-07-09 morning.

Hannah and Tessa — can you please:
- Hannah: confirm the SCIM delta sample and a SAML assertion example we can safely share (redacted).
- Tessa: produce the redaction-friendly CSV export and the short playbook draft.

Oliver — if that timeline works I'll upload to the Drive folder and ping you when it's live.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Manager, Trust & Compliance
Redwood Inference

--- Attachments planned: redacted_service-account-manifest.csv, provisioning-playbook.pdf ---

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Jul 2025 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: service-account provisioning manifest + least-privilege samples for SOC2 intake

Mina / Tessa —

Acknowledged. Quick notes from engineering side: 

- I will extract a SCIM create delta and a minimal SAML assertion (assertion subject + attributes only) and redact any tenant IDs and internal email addresses. I'll save as scim-delta-sample.json and saml-assertion-sample.txt.
- For ephemeral/JIT flows, I'll include a short timeline showing token TTLs, the KMS rotation trigger, and the audit log event IDs (redacted) that show rotation happened.
- We currently apply role templates at provisioning time; the CSV will include the template name (not full policy) and a pointer to the policy document we can share (policy snippets only).

Tessa — can you export the service accounts sheet with these columns: account_id (redacted), owner, purpose_tag, template_name, created_at_utc, last_used_utc, rotation_policy? That will match Medilabs' intake.

I'll drop the scim-delta-sample.json into the folder. Ping me if you want the raw audit event ids as a separate file.

Hannah
Senior Staff, Applied Trust
Redwood Inference

--- Attachment: scim-delta-sample.json (redacted SCIM snippet) ---

From: Oliver Price <oliver.price@medilabs.com>

Mina / team —

Appreciate the quick turnaround. The proposed artifacts and timeline look good. Please upload the bundle to the Drive folder linked below and I'll confirm with our audit lead once we ingest. If any artifact is sensitive (audit event ids, internal tenant mapping) please place it in the DocuSign secure envelope and mark it as restricted access.

Drive upload link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-medilabs-upload
DocuSign envelope (for restricted items): https://app.docusign.com/secure-envelope/12345ABC

When you upload, please include a one-page manifest listing each file and a short redaction summary (what fields were redacted and why). That helps speed reviewers through the packet.

Thanks — Oliver
Oliver Price

Medilabs
